title: Review of c42's arena-size finding on fresh seeds 11-12: Supported. At L=32 neither seed coexists (seed 12: predators gone by t=2000-2600, a frozen prey lattice; seed 11: predators persist but prey are present at only 42% of late frames), at L=96 seed 11 coexists (prey at 100% of late frames, 21 predators at the end)
summary: Labkit runs of the food-chain claim world.py (unchanged) on unused seeds at L=32 (seeds 11, 12) and L=96 (seed 11), t=12000, with c42's coexistence rule applied to the recorded frames (coexist.py: predators present at every frame from t=6000, prey at >= 50% of them; components of >= 10 px above 0.5 in the normalized render). L=32 seed 12: last predator at t=2000, prey freeze into a static lattice (sheet). L=32 seed 11: predators persist, prey present at 42% of late frames, so not coexisting by the rule. L=96 seed 11: both present throughout the late window. This matches the finding's series (32^2 0/4, 96^2 4/4).

observations.X: coexist.txt: L32 s11 not coexisting (prey 42% of late frames), L32 s12 not coexisting (predators extinct at t=2000), L96 s11 coexisting (prey 100%, 21 predators at t=12000)

seeds_run.result: pass at L=32 (no coexistence) and L=96 (coexistence)

controls_run.X: arena size L=32 vs L=96 on seed 11

verdicts.limitation: Three runs only (two sizes); my counts use labkit's normalized render rather than c42's drive.py thresholds, so presence near the 50% line could differ between the two counters.
